notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
Mine Worker does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mine Worker.
description:
Activate Mine Worker by tapping it, causing you to gain at least 2 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Mine Worker.
Repeat.
